description: Wave 2 — August 2026 evidence research. 40 entries covering ELITE (11), ROSE (16), and SKYE (13) collections. All note evidence sourced from Tier 1 (official brand sites) or Tier 2 (Fragrantica, Basenotes, major authorised retailers) sources via WebSearch. LLM general knowledge is NOT used as a governed source. Founder decisions applied EP-CAT-P4B-R1 (2026-08-18): MEN-83 confirmed L'Eau d'Issey Pour Homme; MEN-87 confirmed Le Male; LADIES-207 confirmed EDP (2018); MEN-133 moved SKYE→ELITE; UNISEX-55 confirmed ELITE; UNISEX-64 confirmed ELITE.

governance.researchedBy: Claude Code — EP-CAT-P4B Wave 2 Research Campaign (WebSearch)

sourcePolicyTiers.tier2: Fragrantica.com, Basenotes.net, major authorised retailers (Amazon, Sephora, Kohl's)

governance.admissibilityNote: LLM general knowledge is NOT admissible as a governed source. All claims in this file are traceable to a named external source. Fragrantica returns 403 on direct WebFetch; all Fragrantica evidence is from WebSearch snippets citing the source — classified HIGH rather than AUTHORITATIVE.
governance.schemaNote: This file follows the ResearchSourceEntry schema. Non-standard extension fields (evidenceSources, conflicts, founderDecisionRequired, editionOptions) are included for governance tracking. The ingestion script ignores unrecognised fields.
governance.noteStructureNote: Where a brand presents notes as an unordered bouquet (not a top/heart/base pyramid), notes appear in heartNotes[] only; topNotes[] and baseNotes[] are left empty. This applies to all Jo Malone London fragrances per brand philosophy and Wave 1 governance precedent. By Kilian Gold Oud is recorded as unordered per Fragrantica presentation.
